cases.subject: passive recall queued before the user message is drained AFTER it in the same first request
a passive injection while parked starts no turn and sits in the passive list
the parked recall is delivered with the NEXT message, after it
a passive injection during the turn's first LLM call is absent from every request of that turn (no inner-iteration drain)
the mid-turn recall is delivered with the next message, after it
a tool-using turn parks at its tool-free response: the judge sees 0 real tool results and accepts, so the next drain is the next message
both scope picks are in flight at once (asyncio.gather)
no cap inside the selector: the full pick time is awaited
wait_for(..., 3.0) cancels a 5s seed pick; the cache is left unchanged
seed call keeps 5 profile pins; the refresh keeps 3 (scope default)
build_scoped_recall_blocks has no empty-query guard: the pick still runs (queen_orchestrator._refresh_recall_cache is what skips it)
publish awaits handlers (0.25s handler → ~0.25s); a handler that spawns a task returns immediately while the task finishes later
